notes: Draft configuration: The club identifies Rushmoor Arena as its sprint venue. The supplied historical configuration identifies the simple northern-straight, eastern diagonal and western Arena Lane triangle, rather than the club’s 2026 figure-eight sprint. Exact public OSM road nodes from Arena Lane 69713123 and eastern service road 371693606 form the independently mapped 1,305.3 m closed triangle. Pinned Environment Agency 2020 one-metre LiDAR intensity imagery confirms all three connected paved sides. The current figure-eight, southern Castle Road approach, Claycart Road, start spur, paddock and field-edge paths are excluded. The 23.7 m difference from the supplied 1,329 m remains explicit; private diagram coordinates are not used. Historical travel direction, temporary course markers and exact racing-line placement remain draft. Branch identity was checked against catalogue layout facts and circuit identification references. Independent source distance 1305.3 m; no coordinates are changed to match a diagram or distance. Travel direction and historical alignment remain provisional.

Estimated constant-width corridor: width is stored in track.json; inner, outer and ideal lines are calculated in the browser from the mapped trace. Local widening and earlier boundary corrections are not retained by this approximation.

sources.notes: Road height is sampled from the existing approximately 36 m terrain raster and compressed to a 0.5 m interpolation tolerance relative to those samples; this is not road-surface survey accuracy. Station distances use the mapped trace, not an official length measurement. The saved start gate sets the simulation origin. Curbs and bend labels are geometry-based illustrations, not extracted from imagery or verified real curb locations; widths, heights and colours are assumed. Banking is unknown and assumed zero. Source border coordinates retain their separate feature-level licence; invalid cross-sections are interpolated. Imagery is an external display resource subject to provider terms; no image bytes are included.
